ledger.x: 1359: Albanian clans found the Despotate of Arta in the south of the Despotate of Epirus.
1374: Gjin Bua Shpata takes Arta after Losha's death and unites it with Angelokastron.
1380: Gjin Bua Shpata is master of Nafpaktos again.
1406: Pal Shpata cedes Angelokastron to the Ottomans, from whom Carlo I Tocco takes it within a year (house-of-tocco gain, 1407).
1407: Pal Shpata sells Naupactus to Venice.
4 October 1416: Arta surrenders to Carlo I Tocco and the despotate is annexed.

wars.name: Battle of Achelous (1359)
wars.outcome: The Albanians defeated Nikephoros II Orsini, the last Orsini despot of Epirus, and set up their two states in the south of Epirus; the battle 'won him [Losha] the rule of Arta' (Peter Losha page) and in 1360 Simeon Uros 'decided to leave the areas of Arta and…

wars.name: Albanian wars with Thomas Preljubovic of Ioannina
wars.outcome: No border change: Losha's Mazaraki and Malakasi allies blockaded Ioannina in 1367-1370 (Peter Losha page); after Losha's death Shpata besieged the city, Thomas made peace by betrothing his sister Helena to Shpata, and Shpata 'again devastated the countryside…

wars.name: Hospitaller expedition to Epirus (1378)
wars.outcome: The Hospitaller Grand Master Juan Fernandez de Heredia took Nafpaktos and Vonitsa in April 1378 but was defeated and captured by Gjin Bua Shpata, who was 'again master of Nafpaktos by 1380'.

wars.name: Tocco-Spata wars

certainty.note: Albanian clan lordships with no treaty or survey lines; the 1360 division between Losha and Shpata and every later carve-out (Angelokastron, Naupaktos) are fortress-based and approximate.
